properties.name: Csanakfalu
properties.approximationNote: Coarse analyst-drawn search envelopes from archived actual OSM street/rail/waterway context and named-place points, supplemented by municipal and local-history text. Ménfő/Csanak estimates use the reported boundary marker at Zsellér utca21; Szalmatelep uses the municipal ITS description of a residential enclave beside the former house factory. Original cadastral borders are NOT reconstructed. Uncertain ends and transitions are inferred from the mapped street fabric; overlaps are permitted. No radius or Voronoi construction.
properties.boundaryAnchors: Northern Csanak settlement fabric around Győri/Malom/Királyszék roads and the residential side of Veres Péter utca; approximate southern division follows the Tűzkő-kert/Krudy street belt. Northern/western part deliberately overlaps the modern Ménfőcsanak search area.

properties.boundaryAnchors: Hillside street fabric east of Győri út, around Hegyalja utca, Lankás utca and Székeres Bónis utca; northern margin is inferred at the Tűzkő-kert/Krudy belt. The Zsellér/Szilva/Hegy street belt provides the approximate southern division from Ménfő; no legal boundary claim.
